agent_design_principle: Each agent has exactly ONE deliverable. Phases are composed of multiple sequential agents. No single agent should run for more than 10 minutes.

phases.description: Establish the foundational creative vision for the game. Broken into 7 sequential sub-agents to ensure each task is scoped tightly enough to complete within the timeout budget.

sub_agents.scope: Write the High Concept Document (1-page pitch): game title, elevator pitch, core pillars, target audience, tone, inspirational references, and platform targets.
sub_agents.output_description: A 1-page High Concept Document covering game title, elevator pitch, core pillars, target audience, tone, inspirational references, and platform targets.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Focus only on producing the High Concept Document. Do not begin designing mechanics, systems, or characters yet.

sub_agents.scope: Write the World Lore Bible: world name, creation myth, geography (5+ regions), 3 major historical events, and 4+ factions with goals and relationships.
sub_agents.output_description: The World Lore Bible covering world name, creation myth, geography with 5+ named regions, 3 pivotal historical events, and 4+ factions with goals and inter-faction relationships.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Focus only on world-building lore. Do not write character backstories or story plot yet.

sub_agents.scope: Design exactly 5 playable races: for each write name, lore/origin, physical description, stat tendencies (+/- which stats), innate passive ability, innate active skill, cultural identity, and recommended classes.
sub_agents.output_description: Full profiles for 5 playable races, each with: name, lore origin, physical description, stat tendency table, innate passive ability, innate active skill (name, description, cost), cultural identity paragraph, and recommended class list.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Design exactly 5 races. Do not write story plot or character roster yet.

sub_agents.scope: Write the full 3-act story arc outline: Act 1 (chapters 1-3, inciting incident, party assembly, first dungeon), Act 2 (chapters 4-7, escalation, midpoint twist, betrayal, darkest moment), Act 3 (chapters 8-10, revelation, final dungeon, true ending and alternate ending).
sub_agents.output_description: A full 3-act story arc outline covering all 10 chapters with chapter summaries, key plot beats, and two ending variants.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Write the story arc outline only. Do not name party members yet — refer to them by role (The Warrior, The Mage, etc.).

sub_agents.scope: Design the main party of 6 characters: for each write name, race, class, age, personality, backstory (2 paragraphs), role in party (Tank/DPS/Healer/Mage/Support/Trickster), relationships to other party members, and 3 sample battle dialogue lines.
sub_agents.output_description: Full profiles for 6 main party characters, each with name, race, class, age, personality summary, 2-paragraph backstory, party role, inter-character relationships, and 3 battle dialogue samples.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Design exactly 6 party members. Ensure each party member belongs to one of the 5 defined races.

sub_agents.scope: Write the villain profile (name, race, motivation, backstory, connection to protagonist, final boss reveal) and 15 sidequest hooks (title, brief description, reward type each).
sub_agents.output_description: A villain profile document and a list of 15 sidequest hooks with titles, descriptions, and reward types.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Write the villain profile and sidequests only. Do not redesign story events already written in the story arc.

sub_agents.scope: Review all Phase 1 documents for internal consistency: no plot holes, all races referenced in story, all characters have defined roles, no lore contradictions. Output a QA review report with PASS/FAIL per document and any required changes.
sub_agents.output_description: QA review report for Phase 1 with PASS/FAIL status per document, list of inconsistencies found, and required changes before Phase 2 can begin.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Review strictly for internal consistency. Do not generate new content — only report issues and verify completeness.

phases.description: Translate story and concept into formal mechanical design. Broken into 8 sequential sub-agents, each covering one system or document.

sub_agents.scope: Design the full turn-based combat system: turn order algorithm (speed-based ATB), action types, damage formula, critical hit rules, full 6x6 elemental affinity matrix, and 10 status effects with duration and tick rules.
sub_agents.output_description: Complete combat system specification including turn order algorithm, all action types, damage and critical hit formulas, the 6-element affinity matrix, and full descriptions of 10 status effects.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Design the combat system mechanics only. Do not design skills or spells yet.

sub_agents.scope: Design the skill system for all 6 character classes. For each class create 3 skill branches (Offense/Defense/Special) with 8 skills each = 24 skills per class, 144 skills total. Each skill must have: name, type, MP cost, TP cost, cooldown, level unlock, target type, power formula, description, and any status effect applied.
sub_agents.output_description: Complete skill system design for all 6 classes with 144 total skills in a structured table format.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Design skills for all 6 classes. Do not design magic spells — those are a separate document.

sub_agents.scope: Design the magic system: 6 elemental schools plus Holy, Dark, Time, Support = 10 schools. For each school design 6 spells across 3 tiers (Tier I: lvl1-10, Tier II: lvl11-25, Tier III: lvl26+). Each spell: name, school, tier, MP cost, power, target type, status effect, description. Total: 60 spells minimum.
sub_agents.output_description: Complete magic system with 10 schools and 60+ spells in a structured table, including elemental tier progression.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Design the magic/spell system only. Do not redesign combat mechanics or class skills.

sub_agents.scope: Design the full progression system: XP curve formula (XP needed per level 1-50), stat growth tables per class (HP/MP/STR/DEF/MAG/RES/SPD/LCK gains per level), skill unlock levels per class, and equipment tier breakpoints.
sub_agents.output_description: Full progression system specification with XP curve, per-class stat growth tables, skill unlock schedules, and equipment tier thresholds.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Define the XP and level-up system. Show all data in tables.

sub_agents.scope: Design 30 enemy types (5 per story chapter) with full stat blocks, skills, elemental weaknesses/resistances, XP/gold rewards, and drop tables. Also design the full item taxonomy: 5 consumable types, 6 equipment slots with 5 tiers each, and 10 key items.
sub_agents.output_description: Enemy roster of 30 enemies with full stat blocks and drop tables, plus complete item taxonomy with all consumables, equipment tiers, and key items.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Design enemies and items only. Ensure enemy difficulty scales with the progression system.

sub_agents.scope: Design all UI flows (main menu, battle HUD, inventory, skill menu, magic menu, world map, pause menu, dialogue box, shop, save/load screen) with wireframe descriptions. Also define world structure: overworld regions, dungeon floors per chapter, town layouts, and NPC interaction types.
sub_agents.output_description: UI flow descriptions for all 10+ screens with wireframe-level detail, plus world structure specification covering overworld, dungeons, and towns.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Design UI and world layout only. Use ASCII wireframes where helpful.

sub_agents.scope: Read all Phase 2 design documents and produce the master GDD index file that references all sub-documents, adds an executive summary, and includes the Game Director's formal approval statement with any notes or required revisions.
sub_agents.output_description: Master GDD index with executive summary, document map, and formal Game Director approval statement.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Write the master GDD index and executive summary. Provide formal approval or list specific required revisions.

sub_agents.scope: Review Phase 2 documents for mechanical balance and consistency: check skill MP costs vs damage output ratio, verify no overpowered skill combinations, confirm enemy difficulty curve matches progression system, flag any undefined mechanics. Output QA report with PASS/FAIL per system.
sub_agents.output_description: QA balance review with PASS/FAIL per system, specific balance issues identified, and required fixes before development begins.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Review for balance and mechanical consistency only. Do not redesign systems — only flag issues.

phases.description: Implement all designed systems in Godot 4 using GDScript. Broken into 13 focused sub-agents, each responsible for one script or tightly-scoped group of scripts.

sub_agents.scope: Create the Godot 4 project structure: project.godot (with all autoload registrations, input mappings, display settings for 320x180 pixel-perfect scaling to 1280x720), and GameManager.gd autoload that holds global game state.
sub_agents.output_description: A valid Godot 4 project.godot file with all autoloads registered, input map configured, and a companion GameManager.gd autoload script.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Write valid Godot 4 project.godot syntax. Register all autoloads that will be created in subsequent sub-agents. Use GDScript 2.0 syntax throughout.

sub_agents.scope: Create all Godot 4 Resource class definitions used as data containers: CharacterData.gd, SkillData.gd, SpellData.gd, EnemyData.gd, ItemData.gd, RaceData.gd, ClassData.gd. Each must be a class_name X extends Resource with full @export typed properties.
sub_agents.output_description: Seven GDScript Resource definition files, each a typed data container matching the design document specifications.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Use Godot 4 GDScript 2.0 syntax. All properties must be @export typed. No Godot 3 syntax allowed.

sub_agents.scope: Implement BattleManager.gd as a complete Godot 4 autoload with: BattleState enum, turn order calculation, start_battle(), execute_action(), _calculate_damage() with GDD formulas, _apply_status_effects(), _check_battle_end(), enemy AI with 4 behavior patterns, and all required signals.
sub_agents.output_description: Complete BattleManager.gd autoload implementing the full combat system from the GDD.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Implement BattleManager.gd only. Use GDScript 2.0. Include detailed comments explaining each function's logic.

sub_agents.scope: Implement SkillSystem.gd and MagicSystem.gd as Godot 4 autoloads. SkillSystem: skill registry (load from JSON), use_skill(), can_use_skill(), _apply_skill_effect(). MagicSystem: spell registry, full elemental weakness matrix dict, cast_spell(), _calculate_spell_damage() with elemental modifier, _apply_spell_effect().
sub_agents.output_description: SkillSystem.gd and MagicSystem.gd autoloads implementing the complete skill and magic systems.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Implement both SkillSystem.gd and MagicSystem.gd. Include the complete elemental affinity matrix as a dict constant.

sub_agents.scope: Implement CharacterBase.gd (full stat system, equipment slots, take_damage(), heal(), level_up(), gain_experience(), get_stat() with racial modifiers), PartyManager.gd (active party max 4, reserve max 8, formation system, swap_members(), is_party_wiped()), and RaceSystem.gd (all 5 races, apply_racial_bonuses(), get_racial_skill()).
sub_agents.output_description: CharacterBase.gd, PartyManager.gd, and RaceSystem.gd implementing the character, party, and race systems.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Implement all three character scripts. Ensure CharacterBase applies racial modifiers via RaceSystem.

sub_agents.scope: Implement ProgressionManager.gd (XP award, level-up logic, stat growth application, skill unlock on level, signal level_up) and InventoryManager.gd (item registry, add/remove items, equip/unequip to character slots, use_consumable(), get_item_data()).
sub_agents.output_description: ProgressionManager.gd and InventoryManager.gd autoloads.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Implement both systems as autoloads. ProgressionManager must call RaceSystem when applying stat growth.

sub_agents.scope: Implement SaveLoadManager.gd (3 save slots, JSON serialization of full game state, save_game(slot), load_game(slot), delete_save(slot), has_save(slot)), AudioManager.gd (music/SFX buses, play_music(track), play_sfx(cue), crossfade, volume control), and SceneTransitionManager.gd (change_scene(path, transition_type) with fade animations).
sub_agents.output_description: SaveLoadManager.gd, AudioManager.gd, and SceneTransitionManager.gd autoloads.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Implement all three utility autoloads. SaveLoadManager must serialize PartyManager and InventoryManager state.

sub_agents.scope: Implement DialogueManager.gd (JSON-based dialogue format parser, branching via choice arrays, flag condition checks, variable substitution, signals: dialogue_started/line_displayed/choice_presented/dialogue_ended) and QuestManager.gd (QuestData Resource, 5 quest states, start_quest(), update_objective(), complete_quest(), give_rewards(), prerequisite checking).
sub_agents.output_description: DialogueManager.gd and QuestManager.gd autoloads.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Implement both story systems. Include a sample dialogue JSON format example in comments.

sub_agents.scope: Implement WorldMap.gd (Node2D: 4-directional player movement, random encounter system, _enter_location(), location node detection), PlayerController.gd (CharacterBody2D: pixel-perfect movement, run/walk toggle, interaction raycast, _interact()), and EncounterSystem.gd (step counter, encounter rate table per terrain, check_encounter(), trigger_battle()).
sub_agents.output_description: WorldMap.gd, PlayerController.gd, and EncounterSystem.gd scripts.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Use Godot 4 physics. EncounterSystem must call BattleManager.start_battle() to initiate encounters.

sub_agents.scope: Implement HUD.gd (battle HUD with party HP/MP bars, turn order queue, action menu, animated floating damage numbers in 4 colors), MainMenu.gd (New Game/Continue/Options/Credits/Quit, save slot display), PauseMenu.gd, InventoryMenu.gd (grid layout, categories, item detail panel), and SkillMenu.gd (skill tree display, skill detail, learn/upgrade).
sub_agents.output_description: HUD.gd, MainMenu.gd, PauseMenu.gd, InventoryMenu.gd, and SkillMenu.gd UI scripts.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Implement all 5 UI scripts. Each must connect to the relevant autoload systems via signals.

sub_agents.scope: Create all Godot 4 .tscn scene files as valid text scenes: BattleScene.tscn, WorldMap.tscn, HUD.tscn, MainMenu.tscn, Town.tscn, and Dungeon.tscn.
sub_agents.output_description: Six Godot 4 .tscn scene files with correct node hierarchies and script attachments.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Write valid Godot 4 .tscn text format. Attach the correct .gd scripts to each root node.

sub_agents.scope: Create all runtime game data JSON files: races.json (5 races), classes.json (6 classes with base stats and growth rates), skills.json (144 skills), spells.json (60 spells), enemies.json (30 enemies), and items.json (all items).
sub_agents.output_description: Six JSON data files used as the game's runtime data registry.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: All JSON must be valid and parseable. Use consistent ID naming: 'skill_001' through 'skill_144', etc.

sub_agents.scope: Review all Phase 3 GDScript files for: Godot 4 syntax compliance, all autoloads registered in project.godot, signals correctly declared, no unresolved references between scripts, and GDScript style guide compliance. Output QA code review report with PASS/FAIL per file.
sub_agents.output_description: Code review report with PASS/FAIL per script file, list of Godot 4 syntax issues, and unresolved reference errors.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Review for Godot 4 GDScript 2.0 compliance only. Flag any Godot 3 syntax as a critical issue.

phases.description: Produce all visual asset specifications for the game. Broken into 6 sub-agents covering style guide, characters, environments, UI/effects, approval, and QA.

sub_agents.scope: Write the complete art style guide: pixel grid standard (16x16 base tiles, 32x32 characters, 48x48 bosses), master color palette (64 colors max with hex codes), anti-aliasing policy, outline style, shadow style, animation principles (frame counts per action type), file naming conventions, and export settings.
sub_agents.output_description: Complete art style guide with palette, grid standards, animation principles, and naming conventions.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Define the art style guide only. Include a 64-color master palette with hex codes.

sub_agents.scope: Write detailed art specifications for all 6 party members and all 5 race variants: sprite dimensions, full animation list with frame counts, palette per character, portrait dimensions and emotion list, and sprite sheet layout grid.
sub_agents.output_description: Art specifications for all 6 party members and 5 race variants with full animation breakdowns.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Write art specs only — do not create art. Be precise with frame counts and pixel dimensions.

sub_agents.scope: Write art specifications for all 30 enemies (dimensions, animation list, palette) and all environment tilesets (overworld, dungeon types, town tiles, battle backgrounds: 10 environments with mood and palette descriptions).
sub_agents.output_description: Art specifications for all 30 enemies and all environment types including tileset and battle background specs.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Write enemy and environment art specs. Organize by chapter for enemies and by region for environments.

sub_agents.scope: Write art specifications for all UI elements (window frames, button states, HP/MP bars, cursors, status effect icons, item/skill icons), all spell effect sprites (10 magic schools x 3 tiers = 30 effect animations with frame counts and dimensions), and the logo/title screen spec.
sub_agents.output_description: Art specifications for all UI elements and 30 spell effect animations.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Write UI and spell effect art specs. Spell effects must cover all 10 magic schools at all 3 tiers.

sub_agents.scope: Review all Phase 4 art spec documents and produce the Art Direction Approval: confirm style consistency across all spec documents, flag any inconsistencies, and provide formal approval or revision requests.
sub_agents.output_description: Formal art direction approval or revision request document from the Game Director.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Provide formal approval or clearly list specific required revisions per document.

sub_agents.scope: Review all Phase 4 art specs for consistency: verify all characters/enemies/environments reference the master palette, confirm animation specs are complete for all characters, and check that no assets referenced in the GDD are missing from spec.
sub_agents.output_description: QA art consistency review with PASS/FAIL per asset category and list of missing or inconsistent specs.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Review for completeness and palette compliance only. Cross-reference against the GDD asset list.

phases.description: Define all audio assets for the game. Broken into 5 sub-agents covering audio direction, music specs, SFX/integration map, approval, and QA.

sub_agents.scope: Write the Audio Direction Document: overall sonic identity, instrumentation palette per zone type, BPM ranges per mood, loop point strategy, dynamic audio layering approach, and Godot AudioBus layout (Master/Music/SFX/Voice/UI with routing and effect specs).
sub_agents.output_description: Audio direction document with sonic identity, instrumentation guide, BPM table, and Godot AudioBus architecture.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Write the audio direction and bus architecture. Be specific about BPM ranges and instrumentation per zone type.

sub_agents.scope: Write detailed specifications for all music tracks: title screen, world map, 3 town themes, 3 dungeon themes, normal battle, boss battle, final boss, victory fanfare, game over sting, level up jingle, ending credits. For each: title, mood, instrumentation, BPM, key, loop points, layering notes.
sub_agents.output_description: Complete music track specifications for all 15+ tracks.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Write music specifications only — no SFX. Include exact loop point times and BPM for each track.

sub_agents.scope: Write the complete SFX library spec (every sound effect named, described, duration, trigger condition) and produce the Audio Integration Map JSON file mapping every game event to its audio file, bus, and volume setting.
sub_agents.output_description: Complete SFX library documentation and a companion godot/data/audio_integration_map.json file.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Write SFX specs and produce the audio_integration_map.json. Cover every game event in the combat system and UI.

sub_agents.scope: Review all Phase 5 audio spec documents and produce the Audio Approval: confirm audio direction matches game tone, flag any missing cues, provide formal approval.
sub_agents.output_description: Formal audio direction approval from the Game Director.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Provide formal approval or list specific required revisions per document.

sub_agents.scope: Review Phase 5 documents: verify every game event in the combat system and UI flows has a corresponding entry in the audio integration map, confirm all music tracks are specified, and flag any gaps.
sub_agents.output_description: QA audio completeness review with PASS/FAIL per audio category and list of missing mappings.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Cross-reference every combat event and UI event against the audio integration map. Flag all gaps.

phases.description: Systematically test every feature, mechanic, and player path. Broken into 5 sub-agents covering battle tests, systems tests, story/UI tests, cross-phase audit, and final sign-off.

sub_agents.scope: Write 30+ comprehensive test cases for the battle system covering normal attacks, all skill types, all magic schools, all 10 status effects, elemental weaknesses, all 4 enemy AI patterns, party death/revival, turn order edge cases, and flee conditions.
sub_agents.output_description: 30+ battle system test cases in standard format: Test ID, Description, Preconditions, Steps, Expected Result, Pass/Fail.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Write test cases for the battle system only. Use the standard test case format. Mark all as Pass/Fail pending execution.

sub_agents.scope: Write 65+ test cases for: skill/magic interaction matrix (20 cases), progression system (10 cases), party management (10 cases), save/load (10 cases), scene transitions (5 cases), and inventory/equipment (10 cases).
sub_agents.output_description: 65+ systems test cases organized by system category.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Write test cases for all non-battle systems. Group by system category. Use the standard test case format.

sub_agents.scope: Write 40+ test cases for: dialogue system (10 cases: branching, flags, choices, variable substitution), quest system (10 cases), world navigation (10 cases: encounter rates, location entry, player movement), and UI responsiveness (10 cases: all menus).
sub_agents.output_description: 40+ story and UI test cases organized by system.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Write test cases for dialogue, quests, world navigation, and UI. Use the standard test case format.

sub_agents.scope: Perform a full cross-phase consistency audit: verify story elements from Phase 1 are reflected in Phase 2 design, Phase 2 mechanics are implemented in Phase 3 scripts, Phase 4 art specs cover all characters/enemies, Phase 5 audio covers all events. Produce audit report with PASS/FAIL per cross-phase check.
sub_agents.output_description: Cross-phase consistency audit report with PASS/FAIL per inter-phase dependency check.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Audit for cross-phase consistency only. Do not redesign anything — only report violations.

sub_agents.scope: Compile the master bug report registry from all QA reviews (phases 1-5), triage all found issues by severity (Critical/High/Medium/Low), and produce the final QA sign-off checklist with PASS/FAIL/WAIVED status per quality gate criterion.
sub_agents.output_description: Master bug registry and final QA sign-off checklist.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Compile all bugs from previous QA reviews into one registry. The sign-off checklist must cover every quality gate in the workflow.

phases.description: Prepare and execute the game release across all target platforms. Broken into 5 sub-agents covering export config, launch checklist, store pages, release notes, and final smoke test.

sub_agents.scope: Write the Godot 4 export_presets.cfg for all 4 platforms: Windows x64, Linux x64, macOS universal, and Web/HTML5. Include export paths, icon paths, binary names, feature flags, texture compression settings, and the extension exclusion list.
sub_agents.output_description: A valid Godot 4 export_presets.cfg file with configurations for all 4 target platforms.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Write a valid Godot 4 export_presets.cfg. Use correct Godot 4 export preset syntax.

sub_agents.scope: Write the complete launch checklist with 100+ items in 4 sections: Pre-Launch (repository/build/QA verification, store page readiness), Launch Day (version tag creation, platform uploads, announcement), Post-Launch Day 1 (monitor crash reports, community response), and Week 1 (hotfix readiness, patch pipeline). Each item has a checkbox, owner role, and verification method.
sub_agents.output_description: Complete launch checklist with 100+ items organized in 4 timeline sections.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Write 100+ checklist items. Use markdown checkboxes [ ] for each item. Include owner role and verification method.

sub_agents.scope: Write complete store page copy for itch.io and Steam, plus a press kit fact sheet (game name, developer, engine, platforms, release date, price, feature bullets, key art description, contact info).
sub_agents.output_description: Complete itch.io store page copy, Steam store page copy, and press kit fact sheet.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Write compelling store copy. itch.io short description must be 150 characters or less. Steam description must be 500+ words.

sub_agents.scope: Write v1.0.0 release notes (complete feature list, known issues from bug registry, credits listing all roles, third-party attributions) and the post-launch support plan (hotfix SLA, patch cadence, community channels, version numbering policy).
sub_agents.output_description: v1.0.0 release notes and a companion post_launch_support_plan.md.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Write professional release notes and a support plan. List all known issues from the bug registry with their severity.

sub_agents.scope: Write the final pre-release smoke test report: define and document 10 critical end-to-end test scenarios (new game through credits), verify all platform export configs are correct, and issue the final release clearance sign-off.
sub_agents.output_description: Final pre-release smoke test report with 10 E2E scenarios and release clearance sign-off.
sub_agents.system_prompt_override: Write the smoke test scenarios and issue release clearance. Clearly state CLEARED FOR RELEASE or list remaining blockers.

message_format.message_type: one of: deliverable | feedback | approval | question | escalation
message_format.subject: string — brief subject line
message_format.attachments: array of artifact file paths being referenced
message_format.priority: one of: low | normal | high | critical

escalation_path: game_tester → qa_agent (bug reports and test failures)

quality_gates.name: Story Lock Gate
criteria: World lore has no internal contradictions
All 5 race profiles are complete
Story arc has defined beginning, middle, and end
Character roster approved by Game Director

quality_gates.name: GDD Approval Gate
criteria: GDD is complete with no undefined mechanics
Balance spreadsheet shows no degenerate strategies
All race abilities are unique and thematically appropriate
UI flow diagrams cover all player-facing screens

quality_gates.name: Code Review Gate
criteria: All autoloads registered and stable
GDScript 2.0 style guide compliance verified
No orphaned nodes or memory leaks detected
Core game loop playable end-to-end

quality_gates.name: Art Consistency Gate
criteria: All assets on defined pixel grid
Palette compliance verified across all sprites
Animation frame counts match spec
No missing assets from GDD asset list

quality_gates.name: Audio Completeness Gate
criteria: All audio events in integration map have corresponding audio files
All music tracks loop without audible gap
OGG format compliance for all files
Audio bus routing spec complete

quality_gates.name: QA Sign-Off Gate
criteria: Zero open critical bugs
Zero open high bugs (or all formally accepted)
All test cases executed and documented
Cross-phase audit clean

quality_gates.name: Release Readiness Gate
criteria: All platform builds verified
Store pages complete and submitted
Version tag created in repository
Post-launch support plan published
